7 انبتل It was, or became, cut off, or severed; (S, M, K;) as also ↓ تبتّل . (M, K.) You say, انبتلت الفسِيلَةُ, (K, [in a copy of the M ↓ ابتتلت , probably a mistranscription,]) The shoot, or offset, of the palm-tree was cut off, or severed, مِنْ أُمِّهَا [from its mother-tree]; as also ↓ تبتّلت and ↓ استبتلت . (M, K.) ―
-b2- انبتل فِى سَيْرِهِ He strove, laboured, or exerted himself, and made much progress, in his journeying, or pace. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
